primary_limits.native_ip_host_rows: VM+HOST only; no PORT duplicate-ID gate. Exact native floatingIp attribute and host link with explicit NULL/unresolved statuses; not complete EIP objects.
primary_limits.known_port_eip_host_rows: Known links only. Native PORT snapshot has two reviewed duplicate id keys and may be rejected by strict preflight. Full EIP authority/coverage remains unsupported.

parameters.scope: tenant exact on VM parents only; no default region, no child-tenant filtering

per_CI.request: corresponding build.api_call exact dict, including method/resource/scope/autoPagination

receipt.trust_limit: B trusted normalized assertions, not proof of server authenticity or atomic snapshot
receipt.failure_status: Both resource envelope and each page require ok=True; optional success must beTrue, nonempty error rejected, declared HTTP status must be int2xx; bool pagination is invalid.
receipt.projection: All required row keys are present, unique UTF-8 nonblank id per CI; nullable hostId/resId/devId/portId blanks->NULL. Extra undeclared metadata including child tenant ignored. B loads only returned projections using declared typed zero-row schemas.

parent_preservation: All scoped VM.id retained through LEFT joins, same names distinct IDs; port view fanout one VM×known EIP.id. No private-IP text JOIN.
host_link: VM.hostId=HOST.id, same region guard; missing/dangling host retains VM with status.
port_link: EIP.portId=PORT.id; PORT.devId=VM.resId with same region. VM full directory fetch on port-view checks cross-tenant region/resId uniqueness before parent SQL selection.
roles: No isInternal filter; bool roles canonical text true/false, native text unchanged; both known internal/external roles retained.
native_raw_attribute_limit: floatingIp raw attribute neither expands EIP objects nor supplies missing bindings
failure_policy: Reject duplicate IDs (same/cross pages), missing schema/key, contradictory failure statuses, HTTP errors, partial/unstable pages, wrong explicit scope, malformed/nested/UTF8 fields or identity ambiguity. No empty-placeholder COUNT1.
empty_unknown_policy: True typed zero-row schemas; nullable foreign-key blanks->NULL; display raw NULL/empty preserved and unknown counts separate. B must load prepare projections.
potential_family_count: one new closed family/two views if standalone; not a recalculated132
display_values: Name/IP/native property fields text orNULL; nested/nontext/surrogate rejected. Raw NULL/empty display preserved; requested_display_unknown_counts separately counts distinct displayed identities. isInternal additionally accepts bool->canonical true/false text; native strings preserved. No role filter.
diagnostics: Selected-parent host counts are computed before EIP fanout. Parent population, requested display values and declared known-view completeness are separate. Unresolved EIP/PORT/VM endpoints and unknown tenant/resId are conservative diagnostics. business_complete/full_eip_objects_binding_complete remainFalse for the original complete-binding obligation, even when declared native or known-link values complete.
empty: Successful zero-VM lists produce true zero rows and selected_vm_count0; totalPageNo0 or1 accepted. Failure or missingschema never means empty. Zero known-EIP still preserves parent with no_known_binding, not a certified no-EIP claim.
scope_guard: Explicit region checked on all declared resource rows and all join edges. Native fetch filters VM tenant directly; port view fetches full region/global VM catalog to detect region/resId collisions across tenants, then SQL applies parent tenant. HOST/EIP owner tenant not constrained.
complete_limit: Native view may be adopted independently for declared VM raw-property+host scope after B checks; it does not depend on PORT. Port object view remains known-links-only and global native receipt may be blocked by reviewed duplicate PORT IDs. Key compatibility/nonempty SQL is not full binding business authority.
transport: build reports actual expanded api_call+sql compact UTF-8 bytes; core>4096 => blocked_core_length with boundary/measured bytes/handling. Static placeholder, expanded core, full local metadata and unknown final B envelope measured separately; no truncation or generic rejection of long legal identifiers.
runtime_gates: B trusted request/schema/page receipt verification and actual prepared-projection loading
typed truly empty tables instead of official _empty sentinel
authoritative handling of duplicate PORT source IDs (do not fold)
